Comment CALM for your free 10-minute switch-off 🕯️

Christmas Day is lovely, and it's also a lot. Noise, food all day, late nights and very little time to yourself.

Looking after yourself doesn't mean missing out. It's the small things: water, a quiet 10 minutes, a smaller bowl of sweets and a normal bedtime.

Number 3 is the one I need most. Ten minutes on my own and I'm back to enjoying everyone.

What's your Christmas Day survival trick?

Save this for today, and send it to the family group chat. Merry Christmas from us both.
